special_conditions: Must be a non-farm income generating micro/small enterprise
Trading, manufacturing, or service sector activity

contact_and_apply.designated_physical_office: Any Scheduled Commercial Bank / RRB / NBFC-MFI branch

application_steps: Step 1: Prepare Aadhaar, PAN, business plan, and address proof documents
Step 2: Register and fill the application on udyamimitra.in or visit the nearest branch
Step 3: Select the loan category (Shishu <= 50k / Kishor <= 5L / Tarun <= 10L) based on requirement
Step 4: Submit the application for verification by the bank/NBFC-MFI officer
Step 5: On approval, receive a MUDRA Card and the sanctioned loan amount in your account

schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

special_conditions: Applicant must be either SC/ST category OR Female (at least one condition required)
Must be setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise — trading, manufacturing, or services
Applicant should not be in default to any bank/financial institution

contact_and_apply.designated_physical_office: Lead District Bank Manager (LDM) office / Nearest Scheduled Commercial Bank branch

application_steps: Step 1: Register on standupmitra.in with basic profile and business idea details
Step 2: Complete the online 'Ready to Apply' checklist and handholding session if needed
Step 3: Submit the loan application along with the generated system-tracked application number to the chosen bank branch
Step 4: Bank conducts due diligence, project appraisal, and collateral/guarantee assessment
Step 5: On sanction, loan is disbursed along with a RuPay Debit Card for working capital drawdown

schemes.issuing_authority: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME

special_conditions: 8th Pass (min_education_level 2) required for projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) or Rs 5 lakh (service)

New unit only — existing units already availing subsidy under PMEGP/MUDRA are not eligible

contact_and_apply.designated_physical_office: District Industries Centre (DIC) / KVIC State Office / KVIB

application_steps: Step 1: Prepare project report, Aadhaar, caste certificate (if applicable), and education proof
Step 2: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in under the PMEGP e-Portal
Step 3: Application is forwarded to District Industries Centre / KVIC / KVIB for scrutiny
Step 4: Selection committee interview and approval, followed by bank loan sanction
Step 5: Mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training, then subsidy is credited via bank on completion

Step 4: District screening committee verifies documents and forwards for sanction
Step 5: Concessional funds released directly to bank account with 3-month moratorium
